user.title: HASS Test Data Creator
user.description: This integration creates test devices and test data. Use it only in a test environment, never next to real devices.

create_devices.name: Create devices
create_devices.description: Creates test devices from a template.

template.name: Template
template.description: Id of a template, or custom together with entities.

count.name: Count
count.description: Number of devices, at most 500 per call.

name_pattern.name: Name pattern
name_pattern.description: Name with the placeholders n, nn and template in curly braces.

areas.name: Areas
areas.description: Area names; missing areas are created.

area_mode.name: Area distribution
area_mode.description: Hand out the areas in turn or pick one at random.

seed.name: Seed
seed.description: Seed of the values; defaults to the seed of the integration.

entities.name: Entities
entities.description: Entity definitions for a custom device.

fire_event.name: Fire event
fire_event.description: Runs an action on one entity of a test device.

device.name: Device
device.description: Id or name of the test device.

entity.name: Entity key
entity.description: Key of the entity inside the device.

action.name: Action
action.description: For example turn_on, toggle, set_on, pulse or press.

params.name: Parameters
params.description: Extra parameters such as duration_s or event_type.

remove.name: Remove
remove.description: Removes one test device or one creation run.

target_id.name: Id
target_id.description: Id of the device or the run.

add_schedule.name: Add schedule
add_schedule.description: Runs an action on test devices at fixed, repeating or random times.

target.name: Target
target.description: One of device, template, run or all, for example template: plug_metering.

entity.name: Entity key
entity.description: Key of the entity inside the device.

action.name: Action
action.description: For example toggle, pulse or press.

params.name: Parameters
params.description: Extra parameters such as duration_s or event_type.

trigger.name: Trigger
trigger.description: Type times, interval, once, random_window or poisson with its fields.

seed.name: Seed
seed.description: Seed of the random times; defaults to the seed of the integration.

scenario.name: Scenario
scenario.description: Id of a scenario to run instead of an action.

set_schedule_enabled.name: Switch schedule
set_schedule_enabled.description: Switches a schedule on or off.

import_history.name: Import history
import_history.description: Writes hourly long-term statistics for the past days of test sensors that have a state class.

days.name: Days
days.description: How many full days back from the last full hour, at most 365.

device.name: Device
device.description: Id or name of one device; all devices if empty.

entity.name: Entity
entity.description: Key of one entity, for example power; all sensors if empty.

add_scenario.name: Add scenario
add_scenario.description: Stores a named list of timed steps.

steps.name: Steps
steps.description: List of steps with target, entity, action, optional params and after_s, the wait in seconds after the step before.

run_scenario.name: Run scenario
run_scenario.description: Starts a scenario and returns the number of its steps.

add_group.name: Add group
add_group.description: Groups Zigbee2MQTT devices under a name.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the group, without a slash.

members.name: Members
members.description: Names or ids of the devices; they must use the Zigbee2MQTT output.
